name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
free_limit: Eligible startup applicants can receive up to $350,000 in one-time Google Cloud credits over two years; Start tier offers $2,000 to eligible early-stage MVPs, while funded Scale and Scale AI tiers offer higher limits.
watch_out: Startup age, funding stage, usage history, business eligibility and country restrictions apply. For AI startups the listed maximum includes up to $250,000 in first-year 100% credits and up to $100,000 in second-year 20% coverage; it is NOT a flat $350,000 immediately redeemable balance. Other startups have lower caps, and third-party models may be excluded. Uncovered charges remain payable.
